verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents an `omarchy` CLI that agents can use for configuration, and it has a plugin ecosystem, so a machine-readable spec of its control surface is a fair question for this product. However, no OpenAPI or equivalent spec is documented, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths and llms.txt all returned 404. A CLI with human-readable docs is an adjacent feature and does not count as a downloadable machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
